title: דרך קדומה בצפון מדבר יהודה (Ancient Road in the Northern Judean Desert)
author: O. Sion
location_note: Survey of c. 15 km of the Nabi Musa-Jerusalem road between the Jerusalem-Jericho road and Nahal Og; eastern ascent 18900/13265 to Ras el-Mashhad 18765/13275, western ascent 18525/13265 to 18465/13280. The first reference falls in Z2, the other three in Z3; the quarry cuttings lie on the terrace of the eastern ascent (position between the first two references).
notes: Road (5 m terrace, retaining walls, flint paving, cairns) ascribed by the author to the end of the Mamluk period, probably in use already in the Roman period; lime pit 9 m in diameter used by the road builders (not an eligible class).

features.subtype: elongated quarry cuttings (up to 60 m) on the road terrace, used by the road builders
features.period: with the road: ascribed to the end of the Mamluk period, possibly in use in the Roman period
features.quote: באיזור המדריגה נמצאו חציבות מוארכות

title: ירושלים - ואדי זמרה (Jerusalem, Wadi Zimra)
author: Y. Meitlis
location_note: Wadi Zimra (Jerusalem group heading); no map reference in this report (the reference 17396/13637 on the same pages belongs to Pisgat Ze'ev).
notes: Middle Bronze, Intermediate Bronze and Iron Age farmstead site; Area C1/D sherds also Roman and Byzantine.

features.subtype: bell-shaped cistern, end of a drainage system with two rock-cut pools
features.period: in use in the Iron Age; filled in the Hellenistic period (not subdivided)
features.quote: בור המים הפעמוני והוברר מעל לכל ספק כי היה בשימוש

features.subtype: two rock-cut pools (larger 2.8 x 3.0 m, 0.8 m deep, plastered floor) and a settling pool feeding the cistern
features.period: Iron Age (terrace wall dated to the Iron Age); filled in the Hellenistic period
features.quote: הבור מהווה חלק ממערכת ניקוז מים הכוללת שתי בריכות

features.subtype: rock-cut cave reached by three steps in the north room of a four-room house; holemouth jar sherds
features.period: end of the Iron Age (out of use in the 7th c. BCE)
features.quote: מערה חצובה אליה ירדו שלוש

features.subtype: rock-cut runoff channel along the rock step behind the house
features.quote: לניקוז מי הנגר מהמידרון ולמניעת חילחולם אל תוך

features.subtype: rock-cut pits and cupmarks west of the building
features.period: earlier than the Iron Age building (related to Area C, Bronze Age)
features.quote: מספר בורות וספלולים ,חצובים אך נראה כי הם קדומים למבנה

features.subtype: rock-cut winepress (treading floor, double settling vat, collecting vat); vat deepened and mosaic-paved in the Byzantine period
features.period: end of the Iron Age; Byzantine reuse
features.quote: נחשפה גת חצובה המיוחסת על פי תוכניתה והקיראמיקה שנמצאה בה

features.subtype: system of rock-cut installations with cupmarks and channels
features.period: not dated; sherds from Intermediate Bronze to Byzantine, including Roman
features.quote: ומערכת של מיתקנים חצובים ,בסלע הכוללים ספלולים

title: ירושלים - פיסגת זאב (דיר ע׳זאלי) (Jerusalem, Pisgat Ze'ev, Deir Ghazali)
author: R. Avner, S. Atzmon, A. Sabriego
notes: Monastery founded in the 6th or late 5th c. CE; phase 2 (late 6th-7th c.) inn; abandoned in the 8th c. CE.

features.subtype: two cisterns 35 m south-east of the monastery complex
features.quote: שני בורות מים המצויים 35 מ׳ מדרום־מזרח למיכלול

features.subtype: the two winepresses converted into cisterns in phase 2
features.quote: שתי הגיתות הפכו לשמש כבורות

features.subtype: natural cave with a cross incised on its lintel, 30 m north of the complex
features.quote: שעל משקופה חרות ,צלב המצויה 30 מ׳ מצפון

features.subtype: two winepresses with mosaic-paved treading floors (halls S1, S2) and an oil press in the north unit (built installations)
features.quote: בור איגום ושני תאים במערב מישטח

title: ירושלים - החומה השלישית (Jerusalem, The Third Wall)
author: V. Tzaferis, A. On, N. Feig, Y. Rapiano, S. Wexler
location_note: South of the Mandelbaum Gate, between Sheikh Jarrah and the Old City wall; no map reference in this report.
notes: Layer 3: the 'Third Wall' (1st c. CE) and a tower; a group of iron quarrying wedges on the rock in Area B (not coded as a cache: not described as concealed).

features.subtype: quarry cuttings of large squared blocks over the whole excavated rock surface (layer 4)
features.quote: שרידי חציבה של גושי אבן גדולים ומרובעים נתגלו על פני הסלע

features.subtype: three cremation burials in Roman cooking pots on a rock surface (compared with Tenth Legion burials)
features.quote: שלוש קבורות אפר בתוך סירי בישול מן התקופה הרומית

features.subtype: two rock-cut tombs with a burial chamber and four burial troughs in its floor
features.period: end of the Roman period (4th c. CE)
features.quote: כוללים חדר קבורה שבריצפתו הותקנו ארבעה

features.subtype: three vaulted plastered crypts under the chapel and an ossuary installation with more than 30 secondary burials

features.quote: בו אותרו עשרות קברים בנויים

features.quote: בתוך חצר המנזר נחשפו שני מאגרי מים גדולים וטוחים

features.subtype: two cisterns in the two courtyards of the hostel
features.quote: לשני בורות נפרדים בשתי

features.quote: רשת תעלות מסועפת ומשוכללת שנשתמרה היטב

features.quote: הקריפטה הדרום־מערבית נאטמה ושימשה כבור מים בעל פתח קטן בתיקרתו

features.subtype: north-west crypt reused as a roofed pool
features.quote: ואילו הקריפטה הצפון־מערבית שימשה כבריכה

author: R. Abu Riya

features.quote: מתחת לצינורות נחשפה תעלת ניקוז

title: ירושלים - רחוב השלשלת (ב) (Jerusalem, Street of the Chain B)
author: L. Gershuni
notes: Wilson's Arch summit exposed; street and the vault beneath it dated to the post-Herodian Early Roman period (fills of the early 1st c. CE). The round reservoir, the closed cistern and the Ottoman sabil to which the channels lead are named, not described or dated, and are not coded.

features.subtype: two water channels leading to the round reservoir in the gate square, the closed cistern and the Ottoman sabil
features.quote: שתי תעלות מים שנקשרו למאגר המים העגול

features.quote: תעלת ניקוז בנויה אבן מן התקופה

features.subtype: narrow plastered water channel (0.4 m deep) crossing a paved street ascribed to the Roman period
features.quote: ומתחתיה תעלת מים

title: ירושלים - חקל דמא (Jerusalem, Akeldama)
author: G. Avni, Z. Greenhut
location_note: East of the Akeldama monastery, road from Abu Tor to Silwan.
notes: Ossuaries (one with a Greek inscription, one signed by a craftsman from Beirut), stone doors with iron bolt, wooden coffins, sarcophagus; Byzantine mass burial in cave 2.

features.subtype: three rock-cut burial caves around a courtyard: kokhim, arcosolia, ossuary repositories, stone doors
features.period: hewn in the 1st c. CE, part of the late Second Temple cemetery of Jerusalem; caves 1 and 2 reused in the Roman and Byzantine periods
features.quote: הותקנו ככל ,הנראה במהלך המאה הא׳ ,לסה״נ

author: Z. Greenhut
notes: Cave 1 ossuaries inscribed 'Yehosef bar Qayafa' and other names; coin of Agrippa I in a skull.

location_note: c. 2 km2 around Kh. Jarish; three Iron II farmsteads at 1598/1234, 1618/1239 and 1622/1241; the only eligible feature is in the farm at 1618/1239.

title: חורבת הלל (ח׳ הילאל) (H. Hillel, Kh. Hilal)
author: D. Amit
location_note: c. 1 km north-west of Kefar 'Etzyon, on the new road to Bat 'Ayin.
notes: Layer 1: Jewish estate founded under Herod and destroyed in the Bar Kokhba revolt (Bar Kokhba coin, stone vessels, burnt destruction). Layer 2: Byzantine winepress and storehouse. Cisterns, burial caves, a winepress and rock-cut installations are listed in the layer-1 paragraph as found around the built area without their own dating; coded unknown except the two burial caves the report assigns to the Iron Age.
